methodology: Predictions and optimization receipts were frozen from issue text, pre-fix source, and authenticated target/control execution before post-fix source or fixing diffs were opened.

verified_evidence_receipt.claim: Draft-04 boolean exclusive number bounds create both an inclusive and exclusive check for the same boundary. The converter should emit only the binding exclusive checks, while ordinary inclusive bounds retain their two checks.

A tuple accepts a missing exact-optional output slot even though a later defaulted slot has required output. The hole must be rejected, while supplying the first slot still lets the later default fill normally.

A numeric enum value embedded in a template literal is converted to a regex without escaping punctuation, so 1.2 also matches 1x2. Generated patterns must escape numeric enum text while accepting the literal value.
fromJSONSchema treats a positional tuple with no trailing-items restriction as closed. The default tuple must accept trailing values, while an explicit items:false tuple remains closed.

A record key transform can normalize an input key to __proto__ after the raw-key guard has run, causing the parsed value to become the output prototype. The post-transform key must be rejected, while an ordinary normalized key is retained.

Error-tree formatting mishandles a path element named like an inherited Object.prototype member. A failing toString field must appear as its own error-tree property, while an ordinary field path remains unchanged.
